Tom / Jasmine — Laura from Legal here. Thanks for the redline, Tom. I reviewed your comments and attached an internal markup that addresses the carveout and clarifies responsibilities. High-level notes: 

- Transfer addendum: we propose an addendum (Transfer Addendum - Exhibit B) that:
  * lists in-scope EU/UK regions and the primary host (AWS eu-west-1 / GCP europe-west1),
  * commits that EU personal data will not be transferred outside the list without explicit customer consent or another lawful mechanism,
  * provides a fallback policy for disaster recovery that uses encrypted egress and a documented approval path for any temporary cross-border restore.

- SCCs & signatory party: Redwood will remain the signatory processor for the hosted API; in cases where EdgeGuard requires dedicated private deployment on a named infra partner, we will:
  * list that partner as a subprocessor in Annex A,
  * include a short processor-processor memorandum in Exhibit C clarifying operational responsibilities (KV cache location, access logs),
  * provide evidence for region controls (console screenshots, support runbook excerpt) as part of the evidence pack.

Attached is our internal redline and a checklist of evidence items we can provide (RDW_DPA_redline_EG_comments.pdf). I flagged a few edge cases where we might need to escalate for exec signoff (penalty/indemnity language and long-term data retention carveouts).

I'll join the call to walk through the proposed Addendum text. Suggest Wed 10:30 CET.

Regards,
